insight: Founded by ex-Meta product leaders after a year in stealth; seed-backed by AV8 Ventures, Bee Partners and Race Capital.
name: Okareo
tagline: Simulate real users to ship reliable voice and text agents.
description: Okareo is an evaluation and testing platform for AI agents. It drives an agent with synthetic users ("Drivers") that hold personality-rich, multi-turn conversations across voice, text, and headless channels, surfacing edge cases before release. Teams gate releases on conversation quality in CI/CD, turn production failures into automated test scenarios, and evaluate models, RAG pipelines, and agents from one workspace.

modelSupport.notes: Tests any agent or model; synthetic-user simulation is framework- and provider-agnostic.

edge: Tests agents with personality-driven synthetic users across voice and text in 120+ languages — finding multi-turn edge cases, not just scoring single responses.
pros: One workspace for the full eval loop
cons: Simulation tuning has a learning curve
